source.scope: Shared metamagic apparatus game rules in the already approved item snapshot; exclude editorial pricing discussion, advertisements and artwork.

shared.activation: part of casting the sphere effect
shared.handling: Hold in at least one hand or wear as appropriate to the selected form.
shared.form: Held slender rod, a source-permitted appearance; no weapon attack or armor properties are implied.
shared.combinationException: An apparatus applying multiple metamagic feats at once divides normal daily uses and cost by three, rounding uses up. Multiple talents combined by one metamagic feat are not automatically multiple feats.

cascading-metamagic-apparatus.requirements: Only self-targeted effects of at least one round, persisting without concentration. Each talent CL <=7; sum CL <=9. Use shortest duration and longest casting time.
